title: Create paste and run build script and gitignore
description:
Create scripts/build_all.sh (a paste-and-run build script) and .gitignore for the ShredBoost project.

scripts/build_all.sh requirements:
- Bash script with '#!/usr/bin/env bash' and 'set -euo pipefail'.
- Configure and build using the linux-release preset: 'cmake --preset linux-release' then 'cmake --build build --config Release' (match the binary/build dir used by CMakePresets.json from a.3).
- Echo clear progress messages and be safe to paste-and-run from the repository root.

.gitignore requirements:
- Ignore CMake build output directories (build/, cmake-build-*/), IDE files (.vscode/, .idea/), and OS cruft (.DS_Store). Do NOT ignore the JUCE/ submodule.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakePresets.json from a.3 for the exact preset name (linux-release) and build directory.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/build_all.sh starts with a bash shebang and uses 'set -euo pipefail'
.gitignore ignores build/ and does not ignore the JUCE/ submodule
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add gitignore rules that exclude the JUCE/ submodule
